items.title: Rockwell Automation Profit Rises, Issues Fiscal Year Outlook
items.summary: The industrial automation and digital software company said net income jumped to $346 million, or $3.11 a share in the fourth quarter, from $138 million, or $1.23 a share, in a year ago.

items.title: Emerson Just Raised Its Dividend 7%. Is This Dividend King a Buy?
items.summary: Emerson has lifted its payout for 71 straight years, yet a 30% run in the stock has squeezed the yield to a sliver. Retirees now face a tougher question about what they pay for that streak, and rivals are growing faster.

items.title: Rockwell Automation (NYSE:ROK) misses Q3 CY2026 sales expectations
items.summary: Industrial automation company Rockwell (NYSE:ROK) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q4 2026), with revenue flat year on year at $2.33 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.88 per share was 5.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
